search_results.description: Good Housekeeping recommends seven checked suitcases based on laboratory testing and real-world travel. The Samsonite Freeform Hardside Spinner is the top overall choice, combining a very light 9.6-pound build with strong drop and scratch resistance, smooth wheels, and expandable, organized compartments. The budget-friendly American Tourister 4 KIX 2.0 offers flexible packing, useful pockets, and reliable zippers, though its thin polyester is less durable. Travelpro Platinum Elite is heavier but exceptionally durable, water-resistant, and highly organized, while Away The Large provides spacious capacity, attractive styling, smooth wheels, and strong durability. July Checked Expandable stands out for the smoothest wheels and adjustable handle, although its shell scuffs easily. Briggs & Riley Baseline offers premium construction, excellent maneuverability, and an innovative compression expansion system, but weighs 15.6 pounds and costs over $1,000. Monos Hybrid Trunk Medium suits bulky items with deep compartments and a protective aluminum frame, though it cannot expand and may scuff. Testing covered size, weight, usability, packing capacity, abrasion, scratches, drop durability, and consumer travel. Shoppers should prioritize spinner wheels, sturdy handles, accessible organization, smooth zippers, manageable weight, and favorable return policies.
